content: Affiliate finance tracking needs: per-channel commission tracking (Shopee 3-15%, Shein 2-20% depending on new vs returning customer), ad spend tracking with ROI/ROAS per channel, profit = commissions - ad spend, return = commissions/ad spend ratio. Shopee+Meta integration tools exist (Pixel do Afiliado) but are complex affiliate tracking platforms, not personal finance tools. Key insight: sellers often discover months later that affiliate commissions + fees + ads ate their margin. Finance tools should show lucro por canal (channel profit) not just gross revenue.
